name: 60069 · Lincolnshire, IL
findings: ZIP 60069 (Lincolnshire) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60069 (Lincolnshire) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60069 (Lincolnshire) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
